query.text: 请帮我照看家里的狗，如果它有破坏物品或危险行为，请及时提醒我。
query.text_en: Please help me watch the dog at home, and alert me immediately if it damages items or exhibits dangerous behavior.

annotation.text_zh: 狗狗正在撕咬快递盒，快去阻止它。
annotation.text_en: The dog is tearing up a package, go stop it!
